scenario.shortSubtitle: AI, LLM Agents & MLOps Security · T1195.002
scenario.overview: Picture a wide multi-lane city highway approaching an overhead exit sign gantry and a row of striped toll plaza booths with automated lifting barrier arms. Cruising down the multi-lane express highway, a driver mounts a cloned electronic toll transponder behind the windshield right before entering the fast-pass lane. In this real-world scenario, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the overhead license-plate gantry in tiny disguised batches, then smuggles copied records out past the overhead license-plate gantry in tiny disguised batches. The highway authority’s overhead license-plate camera spots two different vehicles using the same toll pass minutes apart and sounds an immediate toll-plaza alert. In this scenario (T1195.002, MITRE ATLAS AML.T0010, Trail of Bits fickling & HuggingFace Security, PyTorch Pickle Model Checkpoint Deserialization Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: pyTorch ZIP Archive Inspection, then legacy torch.load Invocation Without, then runtime eBPF / Sysmon Detection of Python. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering PyTorch ZIP Archive Inspection, then Legacy torch.load Invocation Without, then Runtime eBPF / Sysmon Detection of Python, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates process, authentication, and network telemetry for T1195.002 across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 2: Legacy torch.load() Invocation Without weights_only=True Triggering __reduce__()
stages.subtitle: Execution (T1203 - Deserialization of Untrusted Data in torch.load)
stages.description: As the car rolls beneath the overhead highway gantry, the toll booth reader recognizes the cloned pass signal and automatically lifts the striped barrier arm. Here in Step 2 inside the highway toll plaza, the intruder bypasses the normal inspection rule to reach the express highway toll barrier without disturbing the local side-road ramp. When an inference or fine-tuning script calls torch.load("model_weights.pt") without weights_only=True, Python pickle.Unpickler executes the REDUCE opcode immediately during deserialization, before the model state_dict is even returned to the caller (logged in Linux Audit Event 59 with ParentInferenceProcess=python3 inference_server.py , PID 8810, UnpicklerHook=pickle._Unpickler.load_reduce, -> posix.system, MitigationCheck=torch.load..., weights_only=True so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes python3 -c "import torch; torch.load('model_weights.pt', weights_only=True)" (which inspects or executes AI/ML infrastructure operations , python3 -c "import torch; torch.load, 'model_weights.pt', weights_only=True" across Ray Dash so that exposes unauthenticated ML cluster job submission, unsafe model checkpoint deserialization, or indirect prompt injection via RAG context retrieval , T1203 during "Legacy torch.load, Invocation Without weights_only=True Triggering __reduce__,"). On the diagram, follow Step #2 / Link #2 (#2→ python3 inference_server.py --checkpoint model_weights.pt / ⇠#2 ACK 59) from Node ② (#2 Perimeter Firewall & NDR Tap) to Node ③ (#3 archive/data.pkl Pickle Stream), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 Safetensors / weights_only Gate).

keySpecs.value: Always pass weights_only=True to torch.load() (the default in PyTorch 2.6+), which restricts the unpickler to primitive tensor reconstruction types only.

stages.description: The vehicle accelerates smoothly through the express toll lane onto the restricted city bypass while every ordinary commuter waits in the cash queue next door. In this final step inside the highway toll plaza, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the overhead license-plate gantry in tiny disguised batches until the highway toll camera log catches the mismatch.
